scope: Mechanistic convergence of independently constrained goal-channel and heading-channel candidates onto PFL3. This protocol does not test physical wind direction, preferred heading angle, DNa02 turning, or odor-source navigation.

primary_goal_lane.semantics: Use the E002b preregistered FB5AB odor-context gate abstraction and the frozen hDeltaG relay. Do not reselect the relay from E002c results.

primary_heading_lane.sign_basis: MaleCNS Cell Type Explorer catalog prediction: EPG ACh, 90.5% confidence, pinned in heading transmitter authority.
primary_heading_lane.topography_basis: PB side/index instance metadata only. Same-PB labels may define anatomical probe groups but are not physical heading angles.

blocked_primary_lane.reason: Delta7 is catalog-predicted glutamatergic and remains modeled sign 0 under the conservative fly-sniff sign policy. The route must remain structural/literature sensitivity evidence unless an independent effective-sign authority is sealed.
blocked_primary_lane.forbidden_selection: Do not promote Delta7 into the signed primary lane because it produces stronger modeled convergence, steering, or navigation performance.

input_semantics: All E002c drives are abstract mechanistic perturbations. PB labels and C labels are anatomical indices only and must not be called degrees, left/right wind, source direction, or goal angle.

fixed_gates.name: authority_hashes_match
fixed_gates.criterion: All E002b qualification, heading route, heading topography, sign, and goal-route inputs match their sealed hashes.

fixed_gates.name: e002b_qualified
fixed_gates.criterion: The E002b qualification seal reports qualification_ready=true on a clean exact git runtime.

fixed_gates.name: heading_sign_policy_respected
fixed_gates.criterion: EPG is modeled +1 from pinned ACh evidence; Delta7 remains sign 0 and absent from the signed primary dynamics.

fixed_gates.name: no_behavioral_oracle_inputs
fixed_gates.criterion: No source coordinates, culprit identity, distance-to-source, plume image, reward, turning success, or behavioral score is available to the convergence graph.

fixed_gates.name: deterministic_replay
fixed_gates.criterion: Identical graph, threshold, seed, perturbation, and drive sequence reproduce modeled state exactly within 1e-12.

fixed_gates.name: heading_lane_cut
fixed_gates.criterion: Removing direct EPG->PFL3 edges abolishes the PFL3 component attributable to the heading-only probe.

fixed_gates.name: goal_lane_cut
fixed_gates.criterion: Removing hDeltaG->PFL3 edges abolishes the PFL3 component attributable to the goal-only probe.

fixed_gates.name: joint_convergence_detected
fixed_gates.criterion: At every frozen threshold with at least one PFL3 body structurally reachable from both primary lanes, joint drive changes modeled state in at least one dual-reachable PFL3 body relative to both corresponding single-lane conditions.

mandatory_reports_not_pass_thresholds: dual-reachable PFL3 body-ID coverage at thresholds 1/3/5/10
goal-only, heading-only, and joint PFL3 traces
same-PB direct EPG subset versus all direct EPG descriptive comparison
Delta7 structural path counts with no signed Delta7 dynamics
forbidden_selection: Do not choose a structural threshold because it maximizes joint response.
Do not infer physical heading degrees from PB labels using E002c output.
Do not infer odor-source direction from PFN/hDeltaC/hDeltaG/PFL column labels using E002c output.
Do not tune model gain or time constants using DNa02 output, turning, source finding, or navigation score.
Do not call joint PFL3 modeled activity a goal-heading comparison until a separate angle-mapping and comparison assay is sealed.
Do not promote the Delta7 lane post hoc.
next_gate: Only after E002c passes may a subsequent experiment bind anatomical heading/goal phases to an explicit literature-derived angular mapping and then test PFL3-to-DNa02 steering through the already-audited E002a scaffold.
claim_boundary: Passing E002c would qualify deterministic modeled convergence of independently constrained goal and direct-EPG heading candidates onto PFL3 under explicit structural and sign assumptions. It would not qualify physical heading tuning, preferred angles, a complete PFL3 comparison computation, physiological firing, steering direction, source finding, or intact-versus-rewire behavioral performance.
